title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE NE DON BOSKO

title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN DON BOSCO
description_en: A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale, which is located on the 4th floor of a relatively new building with an elevator. It is organized in a spacious living room, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony. The property is renovated and currently rented for 650 Euros per month. It has a mortgage and is sold on credit. The area offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life, such as schools, kindergartens, markets, hospital centers, bars, etc. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me.
